summary: Before finishing the budget, {person} sits down with the county parent-teacher association.
realLife: Elrich’s FY25 listening sessions included a meeting focused on Montgomery County’s PTA.
gates: Parents have a shared budget request and the executive is collecting input.
weights: An upcoming school board deadline favors an earlier meeting.
inGame: needs: participation by parents in budget preparation.

turns.what: Parents bring their request to the public hearing instead.
turns.pulledBy: Their association cannot arrange a separate session before submission.

turns.what: The association sends written priorities ahead of a shorter meeting.
turns.pulledBy: Working parents have limited time to attend.
turns.writesBack: The executive's meeting file includes the written requests.
